turns.text: Namaste, main Meera bol rahi hoon, Divyaashree Developers se. Whispers of the Wind ke baare mein call kiya hai — Nundhee Hills ke paas private valley villa plots. Kya aap do minute baat kar sakte hain?
Haan, boliye. Main Hindi mein theek hoon. Ye project kahan hai exactly?
Nundhee Valley, Nundhee Hills ke paas, North Bengaluru. Devanahalli corridor. Pehle ye poochh loon — aap khud ke weekend ghar ke liye dekh rahe hain, ya investment ke liye?
Dono. Family ke liye second home, aur agar value bane to theek hai. Location se problem nahi, hum airport side pehle se dekh rahe hain.

Samajh gayi. Geography theek hai. Budget ke baare mein — yahan plots ninety-two point four lakh se shuru hote hain, takriban two point four six crore tak, tax included. Kya yahi range aap dekh rahe hain?
Haan, one crore ke around comfortable hai. Possession kab ka hai? Ready to move to nahi hoga na?

Sahi pakda. Ye ongoing, phased project hai. Possession December twenty twenty-nine ke around hai. Ready villa nahi milti — aap plot lete hain, ghar baad mein guidelines pe banate hain. Is horizon se aap comfortable hain?
Haan, jaldi nahi hai. Thoda batao community kaisi hai.

Whispers of the Wind ek private valley ki tarah socha gaya hai, typical layout ki tarah nahi. Chhahattar percent zameen open rehti hai — eco-parks, walking greens, aur hills ke views. Beech mein bees hazaar square feet ka clubhouse hai. Plots twelve hundred se lagbhag thirty-two hundred square feet tak hain, isliye ghar landscape ke andar baithe hain, ek doosre ke upar nahi.
Achha lagta hai. Koi expert se baat ho sakti hai? Meri wife bhi sunna chahegi. Kal shaam theek rahegi. Mera naam Rohan Gupta hai.
Bilkul, Rohan. Kal shaam property expert aap dono se private call karenge — koi pressure nahi. Aapka time dene ke liye dhanyavaad. Main aapko ab leave karti hoon.
